//: Vite transpiles TS itself, so tsc is used only as a type checker (noEmit).
`npm run typecheck` is the CI gate; `vite build` does not type-check.
strict and allowJs:false are enabled here rather than in
tsconfig.base.json because the base is shared with desktop/, which has
not been assessed. server/ sets the same flags in its own config.
src/ is now fully .ts/.tsx, including its Vitest unit tests — allowJs:false
is a hard guarantee, not just a default, since there is nothing left under
src/ that needs the old silent-exclude behaviour.
The E2E Playwright suite (tests/e2e/**) is intentionally NOT included
here: it runs under Node, not Vite, and needs @playwright/test's and
Node's ambient types, which would collide with this program's browser
types if merged into the same tsc run. It has its own tsconfig.e2e.json.
